insight: For Haiti, hydration breaks in the 2026 World Cup have generally been a positive turning point, with the team gaining momentum in 5 out of 6 breaks, indicating a slight increase in performance after the pause. On average, Haiti's performance improves by 0.133 minutes after a hydration break, suggesting that the team is able to regroup and refocus during these stops. However, when Haiti is pressing before a break, their performance tends to suffer, with a significant decline in momentum, whereas when they are not pressing, they are able to maintain a stronger pace after the break. Overall, the data suggests that hydration breaks have been a beneficial aspect of Haiti's strategy, allowing them to recharge and come back stronger in most cases.
